rules.name: SQL Injection (Improper Neutralization of Special Elements)
rules.remediation: Use parameterized bind variables (:param or ?). Never concatenate raw strings.

rules.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
rules.remediation: Store secrets in environment variables or cloud secret managers.

rules.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.remediation: Use safe deserializers like json.loads() or yaml.safe_load().

rules.name: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
rules.remediation: Avoid nested quantifiers in regular expressions or use linear-time regex engines.

rules.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS)
rules.remediation: Sanitize and escape all user input before rendering in DOM/HTML templates.

rules.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)
rules.remediation: Validate path against an absolute base directory using os.path.commonpath().
